about: Props a character touches in each scene: adjectives from the script (plus inferred visual adjectives for prop makers), who touches each first, and every transfer. Transfer types: handed, offered-declined, withheld, placed, implied. 'screenplay' is the cited screenplay line, verbatim. 'retrieved_passages' are the passages from other scenes that were given to the model.
